summary.note: Bounded 30-run sweep 2026-06-12 (19:59-20:05 UTC, 366.0s, all rc=0, no crashes). 30 dislocation_event_entry candidates (standalone long-only event entry, min_spread_bps sampled 4.51-6.91, horizon 12/24, cooldown==horizon, time-stop exit). 0/30 passed the standard gate. Failure is structural, not parametric: full-period in-engine performance is POSITIVE in 26/30 runs (best min_bps~6.4-6.6 h24: +43.7%, win 72%, sharpe 0.96, 25 trades) and improves monotonically with threshold, but WFO test-window performance is negative across the ENTIRE grid (-7.4% to -45.6%). At edge-bearing thresholds events run ~1/month, so 2-month test windows catch 0-3 trades each (7-16 WFO trades total vs min 20); at low thresholds where WFO trade counts suffice (20-26), WFO returns are -30% to -46% (noise events dominate). Profit concentration 66.5-100% (max month): the edge lives in a few episodes that fall largely inside train-only windows, so no threshold setting can simultaneously satisfy min_wfo_trades and OOS profitability. Anti-inertness verified: returns, trade counts, and gate failures all vary monotonically with sampled min_spread_bps and horizon.
